A2.title: Group() helper for named contexts
A2.problem: Commands must call Slog().WithGroup("name") and lose the typed *Logger surface (Errorf unavailable on grouped loggers).
A2.proposal: Add Logger.Group(name string) *Logger that wraps inner.WithGroup(name).

notes: Child logger owns no resources (closers empty), same contract as With()
Migrate call sites in internal/infra/commands/cmd_process.go:62 and :91 to drop the Slog() escape hatch

tests: TestLogger_Group returns a different instance and logs grouped output
Errorf available on grouped child logger
A2.outcome: Implemented with interface port: pipeline.Logger interface in internal/app/pipeline/dto.go (Debug/Info/Warn/Error; both *slog.Logger and *logging.Logger satisfy it). cmd_process.go fully migrated off Slog(); pipeline.Options.Logger is now the interface.

A3.title: JSON vs text format toggle
A3.problem: Terminal output is always JSON (machine-readable but unreadable for humans).
A3.proposal: Add optional format field to [logger] config: "json" (default) or "text".

notes: newTermHandler switches on strings.ToLower(cfg.Format): "text" -> slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stderr, opts), default -> slog.NewJSONHandler
Empty format defaults to "json" — no breaking change

tests: Terminal with format "text" writes non-JSON lines
Terminal with format "" or "json" keeps JSON output

A4.title: Color support for terminal logs
A4.problem: Human-readable text logs are colorless; levels don't stand out.
A4.proposal: Add optional color field to [logger] config; colorize level values in terminal text output.

notes: Use slog.HandlerOptions.ReplaceAttr to wrap the level value in ANSI codes
Only effective when format = "text"; ignored for JSON output
No new dependency strictly required (raw ANSI escapes); mattn/go-colorable optional
Colors apply to terminal handler only — file output stays plain

benefits: Levels scannable at a glance in text mode
tests: color = true emits ANSI escapes for level in text mode
color = false or json mode emits no escapes

BUG-1.title: Env.TargetRoot regression: scriptRoot instead of executor target
BUG-1.problem: buildScriptConfig set Env.TargetRoot to scriptRoot (generator dir) instead of renderRoot (executorPaths["target"]), breaking the invariant set in 8e09fec ("paths must be valid on executor"). No production impact: TargetRoot is only consumed by the test-only fallback in script.BuildScript when Predictions is empty.
tests: TestBuildScriptConfig_ExecutorPaths (pre-existing; acts as the regression test — red before fix, green after)
